entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Report unnecessary @using directives in Razor files from the command line #86268
  • Razor formatting issue #86262
  • Incorrect implementation of IsEffectivelyReadOnly API with respect to reduced extension methods and generic construction #86257
    18.14

PullRequests

Created

  • Support adding a marker to LSP Hover responses #86272
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Inline eng\Packages.props into Directory.Packages.props. #86271
  • Flesh out impact of reportTopLevelWarnings and reportRemainingWarnings parameters for NullableWalker.VisitUnionConversion #86270
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Caching compiler: replay diagnostics #86263
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Caching Compiler
  • Handle BOM in file-based app script #86261
    Area-Infrastructure, Feature - Run File
  • [main] Update FBA sources #86260
  • [Roslyn] Reduce work when checking for source generators #86259
    Community, VSCode
  • Support unsafe v2 in declaration generation #86258
    Area-IDE, Community, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • [release/stable] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86256
  • Treat extension methods for value types with ByVal and RefReadonly receivers as effectively readonly #86255
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything

Merged

  • [release/stable] Emit correct IL for exhaustive switch statements that use a separate Dag for lowering #86251
    Approved to merge
  • Update to the latest HotReload.Components #86267
    Next
  • Remove a bunch of ProjectReference Name properties #86253
    Next
  • Unsafe evolution: warn for deprecated feature flag #86224
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution, Next

    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Run File
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3122227 #86164
  • Don't report CA1704 for EventArgs parameters named e #85161
    Community
  • add SemanticModel.GetIterationType and GetAsyncIterationType #86175
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs API Review
  • Preserve speculative binder when checking local Main signatures #86245
    Area-Compilers
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3122202 #86046
    Area-Razor
  • Migrate Advanced options to Unified Settings and keep EditorConfig pages legacy #86163
    Needs UX Triage
  • Add project-system APIs to Visual Studio ExternalAccess #86192
  • Partial constructors: fix symbol events #86154
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix CS8618 suggesting 'required' on events #82424
    Area-Compilers, Community, VSCode
